title: The Denim Shirt (W)
description:
Sourced responsibly and sewn to last a lifetime. ANIÁN denims follow the same principles that inspire all of our apparel—careful construction, everyday adaptability and timeless design. Made from a sturdy, synthetic-free organic and recycled cotton blend that softens beautifully with time, the Denim Shirt pairs the qualities of traditional denim with our circular, low-impact process. Draping naturally with a standard fit for easy movement, it’s indigo dyed in small batches that give each shirt a unique colour profile—reflecting our belief that style and sustainability can go hand in hand.

Small-batch production with recycled content results in natural colour variations and subtle pre-distressing.

Made in Canada

title: The Quilted Wool Vest (W)
description:
Built to move with the seasons, our women’s-specific Quilted Wool Vest offers warmth and comfort in step with nature’s pace. Soft but sturdy, it’s made from our post-consumer recycled Melton wool blend with no added dyes and insulated with low-loft wool batting sourced from leftover fibres in the salvaging process. Balancing durability with freedom of movement for outdoor chores or off-the-grid adventures, it layers easily over your favourite flannel, fleece or sweater. Finished with a knit merino and cashmere collar, oversized pockets and curved hem, it’s a beautifully functional piece that effortlessly transitions between work and the weekend.

Made in Canada

title: The York LS (W)
description:
Relaxed but refined, the York Shirt is made from our lightest woven fabric with a natural drape and a flattering, tailored fit. Combining the airy comfort of linen with a soft, smooth-wearing post-consumer recycled cotton blend, the gracefully simple silhouette has a classic collar, pearl-white buttons and a slightly curved hem. Timeless and adaptable, it’s a summer essential that moves easily from days in the garden to evening drinks at the dockside.

Made in Canada

title: The York Shirt
description:
For patio time with friends or warm-weather work days that call for a classic button-up, the York Shirt gives you cool and breathable comfort with a clean, timeless cut. Made from our lightest woven fabric with a traditional collar and slightly curved hem, its linen content combines with a soft and durable post-consumer recycled cotton blend that’s ideal for casually refined spring and summer wear.

Made in Canada

title: The Palermo Towel
description:
For home or your favourite home-away-from-home, we’ve crafted the simple and elegant Palermo Towel from a soft, two-toned post-consumer recycled cotton blend with no added dyes. Made in the tasseled style of traditional Turkish towels, the weave is a touch thinner than cotton terry—making it lighter, quicker to dry, and easy to pack when you’re on the way to the beach. Like all ANIÁN products, it’s also designed to be as versatile as possible—outdoors, indoors, or even as a wrap, summer throw or patio tablecloth.

Made in Canada

title: The Twill Coat
description:
Sturdy but comfortable, twill is one of our favourite materials for all-purpose, all-season wear. To build this capable button-up that works for everything from early morning surf checks to afternoon chores at the cabin, we took traditional midweight twill and made it lighter on the planet with post-consumer recycled cotton, a soft flannel-like finish and no added dyes. Breathable and needing no break-in, it’s an ideal fabric for those who prefer cotton to wool—but still need enough strength and ease of motion for the tasks of the day.

Made in Canada

title: The Cottage Coat
description:
Inspired by quieter days in the countryside, the Cottage Coat combines a more casual fit with soft, midweight post-consumer recycled cotton twill. Easy to layer in cooler weather and made with no added dyes, it has raglan sleeves, patch pockets with hidden handwarmer pockets and a shorter hem that falls at the hip. Sturdy and versatile for work or adventuring, the supple fabric has a natural drape and a combed, flannel-like finish that lies smoothly against the skin.

Made in Canada

title: The Jericho Wool
description:
With the warmth, durability, and weather resistance of post-consumer recycled wool, this refined button-up is built for all-season wear. Its densely woven mock corduroy is rugged yet smooth, offering comfort through the day’s work. Designed for layering, it provides protection from weather while maintaining an easy, oversized fit.

Made in Canada

16-oz 80% post-consumer recycled wool/20% nylon. Warm, durable and naturally weather-resistant, this comfortable mock corduroy blend is manufactured in a unique dye-free process for reduced environmental impact.

Jericho offers a tailored fit with added room, making it more relaxed than our Modern Melton and ideal for comfortable layering. To fit a more robust frame, we recommend moving up one size. For further details, see our sizing chart.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Jericho Wool

title: The Circular Crew
description:
Even the simplest designs have a story to tell. Made from a sturdy recycled and organic cotton blend with a soft-wearing fleece finish on the inside, our Circular Crew is the result of years of work behind the scenes to make everyday essentials in a way that’s better for our world. Featuring a traditional pullover crewneck design and a small ANIÁN logo at the lower left hem, the heavier-weight cotton offers all-season warmth and breathability with an updated standard unisex fit for comfort and ease of layering.

Made in Canada

title: Bolt-End Overalls (M)
description:
Built from factory offcuts that would be otherwise discarded, our limited run Bolt-End Overalls match the durable function of classic workwear with ANIÁN’s circular, low-waste production. Using fabric ends left over from our coats and shirts, they’re made from sturdy, post-consumer recycled Agnello wool with a post-consumer recycled flannel blend providing extra comfort and warmth in the upper body. Warm, breathable and naturally weather-resistant, they have a standard men's fit for ease of layering and movement when working outdoors in cold and damp conditions. The elastic shoulder straps have metal buckles that let you customize the length; large pockets on the chest and seat hold tools, a phone or anything else you need on the farm or at the cabin, and two deep slash pockets offer more storage or a spot to warm your hands.

Made in Canada

*Interior lining is made from flannel offcuts. Colours and patterns will vary; each pair is unique and may differ from the images shown.

description:

title: The Eddie Wool (800GSM)
description:
For generations, mariners depended on densely woven melton wool to hold off wind and spray. Supremely durable and weather-resistant, our post-consumer recycled Melton has become an ANIÁN favourite, and we’ve now woven an even more robust version. Our warmest and heaviest-weight outer layer, the Eddie Wool is a carefully built overcoat that combines rugged functionality with a streamlined mid-century design. Made with no added dyes and featuring a brass zipper with hidden storm placket to seal out the wind, it’s a versatile, city-or-country style that’s built to last—wherever you wear it.

Made In Canada

title: The Herringbone Flight Jacket
description:
Durable, dependable and absolutely timeless in design, the Herringbone Flight Jacket takes its inspiration from the sturdy, ’40s-era floatplanes still in everyday service on our coast. Featuring a classic aviator’s template and a standard fit, it’s made from a warm and weather-resistant post-consumer recycled wool blend with a smooth recycled nylon lining for comfort and ease of layering. The front-zip and five handy pockets give it extra capability in the field, while a recycled blend Sherpa collar and rib-knit cashmere and merino cuffs add more warmth through the colder months.

Made in Canada

title: The Melton Wool Cap
description:
The qualities that make melton a superior material for cool-weather clothing—particularly its warmth, durability and water resistance—also make for superior cool-weather hats. In a unstructured mid-crown, six-panel design, our all-season Melton Wool Cap is made from the same rugged, densely woven post-consumer recycled wool we use for our Modern Melton Shirts. And to help eliminate waste in production, it’s made from factory offcuts—small but perfectly good pieces of fabric that would be otherwise thrown away. Protecting you from sun, wind or squalls, it has a traditional brim and double vent holes; a leather strap with antique buckle easily adjusts for a custom fit at the back.

Made In Canada

title: The Cordova Coat
description:
With its tailored fit and three-button front, the Cordova Coat has a more formal feel than our other women’s long coats. Made from our warm, weather-shedding post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend with no added dyes, its lofted, bouclé-like outer holds off fog, showers or snow through weekdays on the move or evenings on the town. Shaped seams lend a refined silhouette, while hidden handwarmer pockets, a welted interior pocket and a lower back vent add essential function without sacrificing style.

Made in Canada

title: The Quilted Wool Vest (M)
description:
Built to move with the seasons, our redesigned Quilted Wool Vest is a step up in warmth that leaves your arms free to swing an axe or a hammer. Made from our durable, weather-shedding post-consumer recycled Melton wool blend with no added dyes, it’s insulated with low-loft wool batting sourced from leftover fibres in the salvaging process—holding in warmth without bulk. With two large front pockets, a drop-in interior pocket, amply sized armholes and a boxier standard workwear fit, it combines strength and freedom of motion with tailoring that works as well in town as it does on the land.

Made in Canada

title: Rubber Boot Socks
description:
We hail from a rainy place, and in some seasons we spend a lot more time in rubber boots than we do in shoes. They’re the right footwear for muddy trails and soggy work sites, but they don’t offer much warmth in cold weather, and we could never find socks that would rise high enough to wear with our boots. To us, there was an obvious solution—we’d just make our own. The warmest and thickest socks in our line, the heavyweight Rubber Boot Socks are made from a comfy, durable and reliably insulating double-knit wool that retains its warmth even when wet. With a touch of nylon and spandex for additional comfort and strength, they’re tough and cozy for all-weather wear; to protect against boot chafing, the cuff rises to just below the knee.

Made In Canada

85% wool / 12% nylon / 3% spandex, double-knit for warmth and durability.

Available in two unisex sizes, these socks are designed to rise higher than a rubber boot; for some women, the socks may reach above the knee. Refer to the sizing chart for details.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Britannia Coat (M)
description:
With subtle nods to the English long coats that rested on the shoulders of aviators and infantrymen, the Britannia Coat offers modern functionality while retaining its utilitarian heritage. Made in our unique dye-free process for less environmental impact, the post-consumer recycled Agnello wool outer has a weather-resistant weave that wicks water and provides fall and winter warmth, while the smooth, 100% recycled nylon lining gives easy-wearing comfort. With a relaxed, oversized fit, the classically-cut Britannia moves easily and leaves ample room for thicker layers as the days become short and brisk.

Made In Canada

16-oz 80% recycled wool/20% nylon, lined with 100% recycled nylon. Warm, durable and naturally weather-resistant, the wool outer is manufactured in our dye-free process for reduced environmental impact.The Britannia was designed with easy layering and an oversized aesthetic in mind. We recommend choosing your regular size; see our sizing chart for further details. Spot clean only.

title: The Melton Wool Hat
description:
The same qualities that make Melton a favourite for cool-weather clothing—warmth, durability and weather resistance—also make it ideal for hats. With a mid-crown, five-panel design, our Melton Wool Hat is built from the same rugged, post-consumer recycled wool as our Modern Melton Shirts, using factory offcuts to help reduce waste.

Made In Canada

title: The Pecora Wool Hoodie (W)
description:
From tideline to alpine, almost all of our adventures lead us into cold, wet and stormy conditions—which are exactly where high-pile Sherpa wool excels. To make an all-weather insulating hoody for everyday or far away, we sourced a soft, warm and movement-friendly recycled wool blend. The breathability and temperature regulation of the thick-knit wool—which synthetic fleeces attempt to imitate—give it exceptional comfort and performance when worn on its own or as a midlayer under a shell, and the Melton-lined hood keeps the wind at bay. A fleece storm flap offers extra warmth, while our unique production process with no added dyes helps further reduce environmental impact.

Made in Canada

title: The Pecora Wool Hoodie (M)
description:
From tideline to alpine, almost all of our adventures lead us into cold, wet and stormy conditions—which are exactly where high-pile Sherpa wool excels. To make an all-weather insulating hoody for everyday or far away, we sourced a soft, warm and movement-friendly recycled wool blend. The breathability and temperature regulation of the thick-knit wool—which synthetic fleeces attempt to imitate—give it exceptional comfort and performance when worn on its own or as a midlayer under a shell, and the Melton-lined hood keeps the wind at bay. A fleece storm flap offers extra warmth, while our unique production process with no added dyes helps further reduce environmental impact.

Made in Canada

title: The Northwest Herringbone
description:
Inspired by the past but reimagined for the future, many of our favourite designs merge centuries of tradition with contemporary, low-impact materials. Made from a warm, durable and weather-resistant post-consumer recycled wool blend, this overcoat features a patterned herringbone weave that was a staple of British tailors on Savile Row. More formal than our other outerwear, the fit is classically tailored with enough comfort and freedom of movement for cold-weather layering. Made in our unique, dye-free process, the heavyweight wool is backed with a smooth, 100% recycled nylon lining, and the collar can be buttoned all the way up on blustery winter days.

Made In Canada

title: The Northwest Herringbone
description:
Elegantly tailored and designed for easy layering, this fall and winter overcoat features a contrast-patterned herringbone weave that brings echoes of London street style in the ‘60s. Taking its colours from the original source garments, we’ve made the heavyweight outer from a warm and naturally weather-resistant post-consumer recycled wool blend, while the drop shoulder and oversized aesthetic give you plenty of room to move on morning walks to work. A smooth, 100% recycled nylon lining adds comfort against the skin, while the notched lapel collar has a double-breasted overlap for extra warmth in cold and windy weather.

Made in Canada

title: The Pecora Wool Zip (W)
description:
Bringing fleece back to its origins, our soft, warm and movement-friendly Pecora Front-Zip is built from a thick, high-pile recycled wool Sherpa blend that performs beautifully in cool and wet climates like our own. The insulation, breathability and temperature regulation of wool fleece—which synthetic fleeces attempt to imitate—thrives as an outer a midlayer under a shell, while the full-zip design transitions from city to trail with ease. A fleece storm flap offers extra warmth and wind protection, while our unique production process with no added dyes helps further reduce environmental impact.

Made in Canada

title: The Pecora Wool Zip (M)
description:
With the all-weather performance of natural wool, our warm and comfortable Pecora Front-Zip is built from a thick, high-pile recycled wool Sherpa blend that offers do-anything utility in cool and wet climates like our own. Bringing fleece back full circle, the breathability and temperature regulation of the knit wool—which synthetic fleeces attempt to imitate—provide exceptional performance as an outer or a midlayer under a shell, while the full-zip design transitions from city to trail with ease. A fleece storm flap offers extra warmth and wind protection, while our unique production process with no added dyes helps further reduce environmental impact.

Made in Canada

title: Tin Cloth Hat
description:
Holding off rain and wind, the waxed cotton we use for the all-season Tin Cloth Hat traces its origins to when sailors waxed their sails for strength and weather resistance. Carrying that same durability forward, we’ve built it into a classic five-panel hat with a mid-crown design, adjustable leather strap and antique brass buckle. Designed for year-round wear, it’s become an ANIÁN standard that breaks in for comfort and can be re-waxed to re-up its water resistance over time.

Made in Canada

title: The Tofino Wool Fleece
description:
On wet and windy days, there’s nothing quite like fleece for cozy all-day warmth. Providing the same weather protection as synthetic fleece with less impact on the planet, our Tofino Wool Fleece is made with a velour-like, post-consumer recycled wool blend that’s naturally water-resistant and beautifully soft against the skin. Made in our unique, dye-free circular process, it has hidden side-seam pockets, front snap buttons and a standard fit designed for layering. We’ve also added waxed cotton across the shoulders for extra comfort under pack straps and to shed moisture when fog or showers roll in.

Made in Canada

title: The Tofino Wool Fleece
description:
At home in the elements, the Tofino Wool Fleece is one of our most technical garments. With the natural weather resistance of post-consumer recycled wool, it’s a more sustainable version of the synthetic fleece that’s been an outdoor staple for decades. Offering the durability and warmth you need for everyday wear at the end of the road, the wool velour blend is softer to the touch than other weaves and is manufactured in our unique circular method that reduces wastewater and uses no additional chemical dyes. A waxed cotton shoulder yoke sheds water and provides extra comfort under pack straps; the tailored fit has a touch of extra space for layering.


Made In Canada

title: The Eddie Florenzia
description:
Inspired by mid-20th century men’s coats, we’ve matched the streamlined design of the Eddie with heritage plaids and our comfortable, post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend. Easily worn over midlayers in town or the wild, the sturdy, weather-resistant weave is softer than its Melton equivalent and similar in feel to heavyweight fleece. Made with no added dyes and featuring a brass zipper with a hidden storm placket to seal out the wind, the Eddie Florenzia is timeless but technical for essential warmth in cooler conditions.

Made In Canada

title: The Britannia Coat (W)
description:
As graceful as the streams and forests of the Sea to Sky, the relaxed-fit Britannia was inspired by mid-20th century designs. Pairing a soft post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend with a silky 100% recycled nylon lining, it wraps you in cozy warmth through cold and foggy winters; the lofted, bouclé-like woolen outer has a weather-resistant weave that drapes naturally while leaving ample room to move and layer. Easy to style for workday mornings or weekend evenings, the Britannia makes a perfect companion when you need something more refined than a raincoat or fleece.

Made In Canada

16-oz 80% recycled wool/20% nylon, lined with 100% recycled nylon. Warm, durable and naturally weather-resistant, the wool outer is manufactured in our dye-free process for reduced environmental impact.The Britannia was designed with easy layering and an oversized aesthetic in mind. We recommend choosing your regular size; see our sizing chart for further details. Spot clean only.

title: The Eddie Agnello Wool
description:
Inspired by mid-20th century men’s coats, we’ve matched the streamlined design of the Eddie with our comfortable, post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend. Easily worn over midlayers on the way to work or the waves, the sturdy, weather-resistant weave is softer than its Melton equivalent and similar in feel to heavyweight fleece. Made with no added dyes and featuring a brass zipper with a hidden storm placket to seal out the wind, the Eddie is timeless but technical for essential warmth in cooler conditions.


Made In Canada

title: Lightweight Melton Wool (400GSM)
description:
A warmer-weather version of our iconic Modern Melton, the Lightweight Melton Wool balances easy-wearing durability and weather resistance with elevated comfort for days on the go. Made from a smooth and densely woven post-consumer recycled wool blend, it features a clean silhouette with a simple collar, right-chest pocket, and curved bottom hem, while the two-tone crescent buttons add a subtle touch of contrast. With versatile, wear-it-for-anything styling, it’s a piece you’ll always want on your back or in your pack.

Made in Canada

title: The Modern Melton Wool Shirt (600GSM)
description:
Traditionally used to make pea coats for mariners, the dense weave of melton makes it superbly resistant to both water and wind. A meticulously constructed shirt for the inclement weather of the Pacific Northwest, our versatile Modern Melton Wool is a contemporary take on a timeless design—made from warm heayweight post-consumer recycled wool, it’s soft, sturdy and naturally insulating, with cozy comfort and breathability for all-day wear. As our wool has already lived a previous life—the source garments are carefully salvaged before being sorted, processed and re-woven—it features a felt-like touch that’s smoother than other wools, and it’s manufactured in a unique, dye-free process that saves water and eliminates the need for harmful chemical dyes.

Made in Canada

17-oz 80% post-consumer recycled wool/20% nylon. Warm, durable and naturally weather-resistant, this comfortable heavyweight blend is manufactured in a unique dye-free process for reduced environmental impact. Melton starts out a touch stiff, but softens quickly with wear.Our Modern Melton is cut like a tailored shirt, with patterning that’s narrower through the shoulders and torso with more space through the hip; there’s also a bit of extra room in the arms for layering. To wear as an overcoat, we suggest moving up one size. For further details, see our sizing chart.Tightly woven wool has microbial and stain-resistant properties. Shirt only needs to be washed once a year (if that). Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Modern Melton Wool Shirt (600GSM)
description:
Traditionally used to make pea coats for mariners, the dense weave of melton makes it superbly resistant to both water and wind. A meticulously constructed shirt for the inclement weather of the Pacific Northwest, our versatile Modern Melton Wool is a contemporary take on a timeless design—made from warm heavyweight post-consumer recycled wool, it’s soft, sturdy and naturally insulating, with elevated comfort and breathability for all-day wear.

Made in Canada

17-oz 80% post-consumer recycled wool/20% nylon. Warm, durable and naturally weather-resistant, this comfortable heavyweight blend is manufactured in a unique dye-free process for reduced environmental impact. Melton starts out a touch stiff, but softens quickly with wear.

Our traditional tailored fit has a moderately slim cut; to wear the Modern Melton as an overcoat, or to fit a more robust frame, we recommend moving up one size. For further details, see our sizing chart.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. Melton wool is naturally anti-bacterial and stain-resistant, and to reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Field Florenzia
description:
Field coats have been the outdoorsman’s choice for over a century. Built to last from a durable recycled wool blend, our versatile Field Florenzia breathes well, sheds fog or showers, and keeps you warm in cool-to-cold conditions. The lofted Agnello weave is soft, easy-wearing, and rugged enough for hard work—similar to heavyweight fleece but with a more natural feel. Made in our dye-free process to eliminate harmful chemical dyes, heritage plaids give another nod to the origins of this handsomely functional design.

Made In Canada

title: The Georgia Florenzia
description:
Embracing the natural warmth and weather resistance of post-consumer recycled wool, the Georgia Florenzia moves through the seasons with ease. With heritage plaids and the same Agnello blend we use in our Loft Coat, the design offers cozy, soft-wearing comfort with raglan sleeves and enough room for easy layering. Two roomy patch pockets keep your essentials safe, with hidden side-entry pockets to keep your hands warm beneath; and, to be as gentle as we can to the world we love, it’s manufactured in our unique, dye-free process that saves water and eliminates the need for harmful chemical dyes.

Made In Canada

title: The Denim Shirt (M)
description:
ANIÁN denims follow the same principles that inspire all of our apparel—careful construction, everyday versatility and timeless design. Made to last for life from a sturdy, synthetic-free organic and recycled cotton blend that becomes soft and supple as it breaks in with wear, our Denim Shirt combines the qualities of traditional denim with circular, low-impact production. Durably built with a standard fit for freedom of movement, it’s indigo dyed in small batches that give each shirt a unique colour profile—reflecting our belief that utility and sustainability can go hand in hand.

Small-batch production with recycled content results in natural colour variations and subtle pre-distressing.

Made in Canada

title: The Denim Chore Coat
description:
Do-it-all denim that combines traditional craftsmanship with circular, low-impact production. For the Denim Chore Coat, we followed the same principles that inspire all of our apparel—careful construction, everyday versatility and timeless design. Made to last for life from a workweight, synthetic-free organic and recycled cotton blend that becomes soft and supple as it breaks in with wear, it features a standard fit for easy motion and three drop-in pockets for tools, phone, gloves or anything else your craft requires. A single interior pocket adds even more useful storage.

Small-batch production with recycled content results in natural colour variations and subtle pre-distressing.

Made in Canada

title: The Florenzia Wool Blanket
description:
Made in Canada from our warm, durable Agnello post-consumer recycled wool, the Florenzia Wool Blanket combines natural warmth with rugged durability. Its lofted, bouclé-like weave sheds wind, water and fire while remaining soft against the skin. Manufactured in a unique dye-free process, this blanket reduces environmental impact without sacrificing comfort.

Blanket size is 59" x 64".

Made In Canada

title: The Loft Coat
description:
Fall weather has an artful kind of beauty—and we think Fall clothing should be just as beautiful, too. Soft, warm and subtly refined, our best-selling Loft Coat is made from a lofted, bouclé-like post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend that breathes easily, sheds fog and showers, and keeps you cozy and comfortable in cool-to-cold temperatures. Made in our unique circular process with no added dyes, the weave is lush and easy-wearing, but still rugged enough for weekday commutes or weekend wanderings—similar to sturdy fleece, but with a more natural feel. The silhouette leaves enough room for easy layering and movement, with a long scalloped hem that falls below the seat.

Made In Canada

title: The Georgia Coat
description:
We believe in working with nature, not against it. Made from a soft, lofted post-consumer recycled Agnello wool blend, the casually elegant Georgia Coat offers natural warmth and weather resistance to move through the seasons with ease. Designed for layering comfort, it features raglan sleeves, caramel buttons, two roomy patch pockets and two hidden side-entry pockets to keep your hands warm on chilly days. And, to be as gentle as we can to the world we love, the Georgia is manufactured in our unique, dye-free process that saves water and eliminates the need for harmful chemical dyes.

Made In Canada

title: The Berlino Wool
description:
Now with a looser fit for easier layering and movement, the midweight Berlino is a laidback button-up designed for shoulder seasons—or any season, in fact. Made from a comfortable post-consumer recycled wool blend with no added dyes, it can be worn on its own or as an overshirt and is softer and more loosely woven than our heavier-weight shirts. Offering warmth on cool days and breathability on warmer ones, the versatile silhouette features two side-seam pockets and a curved hem.

Made in Canada

title: The Berlino Wool
description:
Now with more room to move, this versatile, all-season midweight shirt is made from a soft and durable post-consumer recycled wool blend that offers warmth when needed and breathability when not. Worn on its own or easily layered as an overshirt, it has a looser weave than our heavier-weight shirts but plenty of strength for off-grid wear. Made in our unique dye-free process with an updated standard fit, the design features two chest pockets and a straight hem.

Made in Canada

title: The Cashmino Crewneck
description:
A go-to for weather fair or foul, we’ve made our version of the traditional crewneck sweater more sustainable by using as much recycled content as we could without sacrificing longevity and durability. Knit from a soft all-natural blend, the Cashmino Crewneck Sweater combines the warmth and strength of merino with the unmatched comfort of cashmere. The standard unisex fit lets you easily layer a shell, overshirt or work jacket in cold or wet conditions.

Made in Canada

title: The Sunday Flannel
description:
As easy as a Sunday morning, our favourite midweight flannel shirt is sewn from soft and sturdy post-consumer recycled cotton with a natural drape. Blending comfort and simplicity, the design features a tailored, feminine fit with a classic collar, matte buttons and single-button sleeves. Made in our unique dye-free process for less environmental impact, its smoothly brushed finish and longer scooped hem give it a blissfully laidback feel on any day of the week.

Made in Canada

title: The Sunday Flannel
description:
As easy as a Sunday morning, our go-to midweight flannel shirt is crafted from soft and sturdy post-consumer recycled cotton with a smoothly brushed finish. Bringing together comfort and simplicity, it features a tailored fit with matte buttons, double-button sleeves, a curved hem and a casual, no-pocket front. Made in our unique dye-free process for less environmental impact, it’s a longtime favourite from the backyard to the backcountry—no matter what day of the week.

Made in Canada

title: The Juan De Fuca Tee
description:
Through summer hikes, fall campfires and stormy winter swells, the forests and beaches of Juan de Fuca Provincial Park have been a constant refuge for all of us at ANIÁN. Made from the same soft, sturdy and comfortable recycled and organic cotton jersey blend we use for our all-natural Circular Tees, this graphic t-shirt is a tribute to one of our favourite places on Earth. 20% of each sale goes to the non-profit BC Parks Foundation to help them preserve and protect our most treasured wild places.

Made in Canada

title: The BC Parks Tee
description:
Our home province has one of the largest networks of parks and Indigenous protected areas in the world—offering not just endless exploration, but also giving refuge to threatened species and ecosystems. But it takes hard work and resources to keep our parks and wild places beautiful, so we’re donating 20% of sales from the BC Parks Tee to the non-profit BC Parks Foundation. With a hand-drawn graphic on the back, it’s made from the same soft, sturdy and comfortable recycled and organic cotton jersey blend we use for our all-natural Circular Tees.

Made in Canada

description:
Our home province has one of the largest networks of parks and Indigenous protected areas in the world—offering not just endless exploration, but also giving refuge to threatened species and ecosystems. title: The Juan De Fuca Crop Tee
description:
Through summer hikes, fall campfires and stormy winter swells, the forests and beaches of Juan de Fuca Provincial Park have been a constant refuge for all of us at ANIÁN. A tribute to one of our favourite places on Earth, the Juan de Fuca Crop Tee has a shorter hem and a hand-drawn graphic on the back. Soft, sturdy and comfortable, it’s made from the same recycled and organic cotton blend we use for our all-natural Circular Tees, and 20% of each sale goes to the non-profit BC Parks Foundation to help them preserve and protect our most treasured wild places.

Made in Canada

title: The Field Coat
description:
Field coats have been the outdoorsman’s choice for over a century. Built to last from a durable recycled wool blend, the versatile ANIÁN version breathes well, sheds fog or showers, and keeps you warm in cool-to-cold conditions. The lofted Agnello weave is soft, easy-wearing, and rugged enough for hard work—similar to heavyweight fleece but with a more natural feel. Made in our dye-free process to eliminate harmful chemical dyes, this handsomely functional design has become the trusted foundation of our Men’s outerwear range.

Made In Canada

title: Recycled Cashmere Beanie
description:
All-season, all-weather warmth and comfort, whether you’re hiking in the backcountry, working through chores at the cabin or out dog-walking close to home. Based on the simple beanie design that’s kept sailors and labourers warm for centuries, our Recycled Cashmere Beanie is made from a beautifully soft blend of merino wool and recycled cashmere with a close-fitting, low-crown design. Lighter-weight than our Recycled Cashmere Toque, the merino content offers the natural insulation and moisture management of wool, while the cashmere reduces environmental impact and adds an even smoother feel.


Made In Canada

title: The Melton Wool Blanket
description:
Made from our heavyweight Modern Melton post-consumer recycled wool blend, this handsomely finished indoor or outdoor blanket has a dense, durable weave that holds off dirt and is remarkably warm and water-resistant—and unlike synthetic blankets, it’s naturally fire-resistant too. Throw-sized, light to carry, and easily packable for cookouts, camping trips or nights sleeping under the stars, the Melton Wool Blanket has no added dyes and is machine washable if necessary.

Made in Canada

17-oz 80% post-consumer recycled wool/20% nylon. Warm, durable and naturally water-resistant, this comfortable blend is manufactured in a unique dye-free process for reduced environmental impact.

59 inches x 64 inches.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. Melton wool is naturally antibacterial and stain-resistant, and to reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing will also give the blanket a longer life.

title: The Studio Shirt
description:
Finding an artful balance between relaxed and refined, the Studio Shirt pairs a tailored silhouette with one of our favourite materials—a soft, breathable and lighter-weight post-consumer recycled cotton blend. Made with no added dyes, the herringbone weave is beautifully comfortable against the skin, and the design features a simple collar, single front pocket and scalloped hem. Slightly upscale but sewn to last, it’s an easily elegant style for days at work or evenings out as the weather starts to warm.

Made in Canada

title: The Studio Shirt
description:
Finding an artful balance between relaxed and refined, the Studio Shirt pairs a tailored silhouette with one of our favourite materials—a soft, breathable and lighter-weight post-consumer recycled cotton blend. Made with no added dyes, the herringbone weave is beautifully comfortable against the skin, and the design features a simple button-down collar, single front pocket and curved bottom hem. Slightly upscale but sewn to last, it’s an easily elegant style for days at work or evenings out as the weather starts to warm.

Made in Canada

title: The Terry Short
description:
Made from super-soft 100% organic cotton, the laidback Terry Shorts pair with the Terry Camp Shirt for tropical relaxation on the most sun-soaked of summer days. Featuring an airy, towel-like and all-natural terry knit, they’re a step up in both style and comfort after a long day in the water; a standard fit gives you plenty of freedom to move, and the design has two slanted front pockets and an elastic waistband with drawstring for a custom fit.

Made in Canada

title: The Terry Camp
description:
No resort required. Offering laidback luxury for barefoot days at your favourite beach, the Terry Camp Shirt is made from super-soft 100% organic cotton terry. Covering you up in airy, towel-like comfort, it works perfectly on its own, paired with the Terry Shorts or as a cover-up over a swimsuit on the sunniest afternoons; the design has an open camp collar, tropic-inspired coconut buttons and a slightly rounded hem.

Made in Canada

title: The Terry Short
description:
All-natural and all-organic, our super-soft Terry Shorts are made for easy comfort on sunny summer days. Featuring an airy and towel-like 100% organic cotton terry knit, they’re a perfect summer style paired with the Terry Camp Shirt or worn over a swimsuit on the way to the beach; the simple and versatile design has a high-rise waist, two slanted front pockets and a notched hem that falls at mid-thigh.

Made in Canada

title: The Haro LS
description:
From sunlit mornings to easy-going afternoons, the airy, Long-Sleeved Haro Shirt offers casual spring and summer comfort in a relaxed, oversized fit. Made from our lightest woven fabric with no added dyes, its linen content combines with a soft and breathable post-consumer recycled cotton blend that’s perfect for warm-weather wear. Beautifully versatile for town, travel or beach, it has a classic collar, pearl buttons, and raglan sleeves for effortless freedom of movement.

Made in Canada

title: The Haro Crop Shirt
description:
Whether it’s sunny beach days or breezy bike rides, the Short-Sleeved Haro Shirt is made from our lightest woven fabric with no added dyes. Offering airy and breathable warm-weather comfort, its linen content combines with a soft and durable post-consumer recycled cotton blend that’s perfect for spring and summer wear. On its own or as a cover-up over a tank or bikini top, it has a slightly boxier silhouette with pearl buttons, a classic collar and a shorter straight hem.

Made in Canada

title: The Circular Shorts
description:
In these do-it-all shorts for long summer days, you’ll find casual comfort matched with circular production that takes it easy on our planet. Made from a sturdy, soft-wearing recycled and organic cotton blend that reduces the need for new material and avoids the use of conventionally-grown cotton, they offer excellent breathability and freedom of movement in warmer weather. A structured cut sets them apart from gym shorts, while the elastic waistband and drawstring keep them properly in place.

Made in Canada

title: The Circular Shorts
description:
Perfectly leisurely, but still sophisticated enough for café days or summer wear around town, our breezy Circular Shorts pair casual comfort with circular production that takes it easy on our planet. Made from a sturdy, soft-wearing recycled and organic cotton blend that reduces the need for new material and avoids the use of conventionally-grown cotton, they offer all-day breathability and freedom of movement in warmer weather, with a high rise waist and a notched hem that falls at the mid-thigh.

Made in Canada

title: The  Haro SS
description:
For days of calm seas and hot sun, the Short-Sleeved Haro Shirt is made from our lightest woven fabric with no added dyes. Offering airy and breathable warm-weather comfort, its linen content combines with a soft and durable post-consumer recycled cotton blend that’s ideal for spring and summer wear. Featuring a camp collar and moderately slim fit, the Haro has pearl buttons, a straight hem, and a box pleat at the center back for easy freedom of motion.

Made in Canada

title: Lightweight Melton Wool (400GSM)
description:
A warmer-weather version of our iconic Modern Melton, the Lightweight Melton Wool balances durability and weather resistance with elevated comfort for days on the move. Made from a smooth and densely woven post-consumer recycled wool blend, it has a tailored fit that features a simple collar, left-chest pocket and curved bottom hem; the two-tone crescent buttons are based on Canadian military buttons from the Second World War. With a versatile, wear-it-for-anything design, it’s a shirt you’ll always want on your back or in your pack.

Made in Canada

• Smooth 12-oz 80% post-consumer recycled wool/20% nylon is comfortable, durable and naturally weather-resistant
• Colours come from the original source garments; dye-free recycling process saves water and eliminates the use of harmful chemical dyes
• Double yoke across the upper back for additional comfort and strength
• Pleats on back shoulders for more freedom of movement
• Two-tone buttons, double-button cuffs and curved hem

Our tailored fit has a structured, moderately slim cut. To wear over layers, or to fit a more robust frame, we recommend moving up one size. See our sizing chart for further details.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Haro LS
description:
Beach, backyard, or boat—for any location of warm-weather relaxation, the Long-Sleeve Haro Shirt gives you breathable comfort in a roomy, more casual cut. Made from our lightest woven fabric with no added dyes, its linen content combines with a soft and durable post-consumer recycled cotton blend that’s ideal for spring and summer wear. Taking its name from an ocean strait near ANIÁN’s home, the Haro’s easy-going design features pearl buttons, a classic collar and a single drop-in pocket.

Made in Canada

• 10-oz 41% post-consumer recycled cotton/24% linen/23% cotton/12% nylon is soft, durable, and breathable for warm-weather comfort
• Colours come from the original source garments; dye-free recycling process saves water and eliminates the use of harmful chemical dyes
• Classic collar and button-up front
• Center-back box pleat for more freedom of movement
• Drop-in pocket on left chest
• Pearl buttons, double-button sleeve plackets, hang loop and curved hem

Our relaxed fit has a roomier, more casual cut than our other Men’s shirts. See our sizing chart for further details.

Wash in cold water (machine washable) and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Vintage Cap
description:
Whether you’re on the go or spending a slow Sunday beachside, the Vintage Cap is a statement of simplicity that ensures you stay shaded while doing what you do best. As a lightweight and absorbent alternative to our more technical line of headwear, this six-panel cap is made from soft distressed washed cotton that promises breathability and no-itch comfort all day. Featuring a pre-curved brim, pull strap and brushed brass embossed buckle for a customizable fit, and vent holes for thermal regulation, the Vintage Cap is a versatile piece perfect for transitioning into warmer months.

Made in Canada

100% cotton.

One size fits all, with an adjustable strap at the back. Depth is 4.5”.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To give the strap and buckle a longer life, we recommend washing only when necessary. We also recommend a quick rinse in fresh water if the hat has been exposed to salt water.

title: The Timber Coat
description: The union of comfort and durability have made twill one of our favourite materials, and the ideal choice for the Twill Coat. Originally woven for field and forest workers, we’ve taken the best of traditional workwear twill and made it lighter on the planet with sturdy post-consumer recycled cotton, a soft flannel-like finish and no added dyes. Breathable and needing no break-in, it’s a superior fabric for those who prefer cotton to wool—but still need plenty of warmth, strength, and ease of motion for cooler days when there’s work to be done. Made in Canada

title: The Harvest Jacket
description:
Spring planting brings summer harvests. Sewn for soft-wearing comfort with a natural drape, the Harvest Jacket is made from supple midweight post-consumer recycled cotton twill with a tailored fit. Pairing a traditional work material with our circular sourcing and production, it’s a versatile, grab-and-go design with a smooth, flannel-like finish and no added dyes. Dressed up or down, the Harvest is a perfect companion if you prefer cotton to wool but still want plenty of practicality and freedom of movement for whatever the season has in store.

Made in Canada

• Supple 15-oz 80% post-consumer recycled cotton/20% nylon combines natural durability with the combed softness of flannel
• Colours come from the original source garments; dye-free recycling process saves water and eliminates the use of harmful chemical dyes
• Double yoke across the upper back for additional comfort and strength
• Twin back pleats for freedom of movement
• Three roomy, double-stitched front patch pockets
• Black buttons, single-button cuffs and straight hem

Our tailored fit has a structured, moderately slim silhouette. For more casual styling, or to wear over thick layers, we recommend moving up one size. See our sizing chart for further details.

Wash in cold water (machine washable) and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: Past Season Cottage Coat
description:
Inspired by quieter days in the countryside, the Cottage Coat combines a more casual fit with soft, midweight post-consumer recycled cotton twill. Easy to layer in cooler weather and made with no added dyes, it has raglan sleeves, patch pockets with hidden handwarmer pockets and a shorter hem that falls at the hip. Sturdy and versatile for work or adventuring, the supple fabric has a natural drape and a combed, flannel-like finish that lies smoothly against the skin.

Made in Canada

• Supple 15-oz 80% post-consumer recycled cotton/20% nylon combines natural durability with the combed softness of flannel
• Colours come from the original source garments; dye-free recycling process saves water and eliminates the use of harmful chemical dyes
• Raglan sleeves for ease of movement through the shoulders and arms
• Two drop-in patch pockets with two hidden, side-entry handwarmer pockets behind
• Turned caramel buttons, single-button cuffs and shorter straight hem

Our standard fit has a regular silhouette that offers more room to move and layer than our tailored styles. See our sizing chart for further details.

Wash in cold water (machine washable) and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: Recycled Cashmere Toque
description:
On the Northwest coast, a good toque is a true essential. A thicker and warmer design that’s kept us warm through many fall storms and winter snows, the unisex Recycled Cashmere Toque is a longtime ANIÁN favourite made from an incredibly soft merino wool and recycled cashmere blend. The merino offers the natural, warm-even-when-wet insulation of wool, while the cashmere reduces environmental impact and lends exceptional softness for everyday wear.


Made In Canada

Knit from a soft, warm and remarkably comfortable 50% merino/50% recycled cashmere blend.

One size fits all.

We recommend dry cleaning our wool toques. If dry cleaning isn’t available, gently wash by hand and lie flat to dry. Hanging a wet wool toque may stretch it out of shape.

title: Chica Wool Socks
description:
Ladies, let no toes go cold. Designed specifically for women, our cozy and durable Chica Wool Socks wrap your feet in contented warmth on cabin weekends or trips up the coast. Since we lose heat into cold ground through the bottoms of our feet, we make these from a sturdy midweight wool blend with a slipper-like, double-knit sole that for additional cushioning and insulation; nylon and spandex add an extra touch of comfort and breathability for long days in Blundstones or hiking boots. The design is machine washable and rises midway up the calf.

70% wool / 28% nylon / 2% spandex.

Available in one Women’s size; refer to the size chart for details.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Circular Henley
description:
Born from the breaking of tradition, a team of rowers in the English town of Henley-on-Thames began practicing in simple shirts that offered more freedom of movement. Never shy of breaking a tradition or two ourselves, we’ve taken that iconic Henley shirt and reimagined it through our own principles. Made from a midweight recycled and organic cotton blend, the Circular Henley shirt offers easy-wearing comfort, breathability and strength—and exemplifies our belief that everyday staples can be produced in a more responsible way.

Made in Canada

Midweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton jersey. Sturdy, comfortable and breathable, this recycled and organic blend is slightly heavier than most conventional cotton jersey.

Standard unisex fit, based on Men's sizing with a slightly longer hem. For most women, size down one from traditional size.

Wash in cold water (machine washable) and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Circular Crop Tee
description:
Just like ANIÁN itself, our Circular Tees are the result of years of work to show that a circular economy is possible. Made from a sturdy, soft-wearing recycled and organic cotton blend that reduces the need for new material and avoids the use of conventionally-grown cotton, they offer all-natural comfort for everyday wear. With a simple crewneck and shorter hem, the Circular Crop Tee is a graceful basic that’s sure to become one of your spring and summer favourites.

Made in Canada

Lightweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton jersey.

Our women’s crop t-shirt's have a standard everyday fit and feel — hanging graceful of the shoulders and lands just above the hips.

Wash with similar colours in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Circular Tee
description:
Just like ANIÁN itself, our Circular T-shirts are the result of years of work to show that a circular economy is possible. Made from a sturdy, soft-wearing recycled and organic cotton blend that reduces the need for new material and avoids the use of conventionally-grown cotton, they offer all-natural comfort and breathability on their own or under layers. Slightly heavier in weight than most tees for additional strength, they’re everyday favourites ready for a long and well-lived life.

Made in Canada

Midweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton jersey. Sturdy, comfortable and breathable, this recycled and organic blend is slightly heavier than most conventional cotton T-shirts.

Our t-shirts have a standard unisex fit based on Men’s sizing — not too loose and not too tight.

Wash with similar colours in cold water and hang to dry. Avoid spot cleaning products with soaps. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Coastal Crop Tee
description:
North of Vancouver, the Pacific coast becomes a labyrinth of islands, reefs and fogged-in fjords—and according to old maps, a few sea monsters too. Paying homage to the myth and beauty of ANIÁN’s home waters, the Coastal Crop Tee has a shorter hem and a historic, hand-drawn chart on the back. Soft, sturdy and comfortable, it’s made from the same recycled and organic cotton we use for our all-natural Circular Tees.

Made in Canada

Lightweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton jersey.

Our women’s crop t-shirt have a standard everyday fit and feel — hanging graceful of the shoulder and lands just above the hips.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Coastal Tee
description:
North of Vancouver, the Pacific coast becomes a labyrinth of islands, reefs and fogged-in fjords—and according to old maps, a few sea monsters too. Paying homage to the myth and beauty of ANIÁN’s home waters, the new Circular Coastal Tee features a historic, hand-drawn chart on the same soft, sturdy and comfortable recycled and organic cotton jersey we use for our all-natural Circular Tees.

Made in Canada

Midweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton jersey. Sturdy, comfortable and breathable, this recycled and organic blend is slightly heavier than most conventional cotton T-shirts.

Our T-shirts have a standard unisex fit based on Men’s sizing — not too loose and not too tight.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Van Isle Crop Tee
description:
The rugged coastline of Vancouver Island was the original inspiration for our company, and it still inspires us every single day. With a simple crewneck, a shorter hem and a hand-drawn map on the back, the Van Isle Crop Tee is made from the same soft, sturdy and comfortable recycled and organic cotton we use for our Circular Tees. A playful tribute to ANIÁN’s home, it’s ready for morning wanders or afternoon rambles anywhere from Cook Street to Cape Scott.

Made in Canada

Lightweight 50% recycled cotton/50% organic cotton.

Our women’s crop t-shirt have a standard everyday fit and feel — hanging graceful of the shoulder and lands just above the hips.

Machine Washable. Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: The Van Isle Tee
description:
The rugged coastline of Vancouver Island was the original inspiration for our company, and it still inspires us every single day. A more sustainable version of a longtime ANIÁN classic, the Van Isle Tee is made from the same soft, sturdy and comfortable recycled and organic cotton jersey we use for our Circular Tees. With a hand-drawn map on the back, it’s a tribute to home that we take with us almost everywhere we go.

Made in Canada

Soft 100% ringspun cotton.Unisex fit based on Men's sizing; With a slightly longer sleeve, the Van Isle Tee sits somewhere between a standard and slightly more relaxed t-shirt fit.Machine Washable. Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.

title: Classic Wool Camp Socks
description:
As classic as coffee and steel cut oats—which is to say, pretty classic indeed—these are the socks you’ll reach for almost every morning, whether out adventuring or just crossing Tuesday off the week. Made from a warm and durable midweight wool blend, our Classic Wool Camp Socks are thick enough to wear hiking but also comfy and breathable enough for bike rides or days spent tackling errands downtown. The acrylic and nylon content gives them a soft feel against the skin, and they’re machine washable like all Anián socks. The design rises midway up the calf, and an old-school red stripe adds even more classicness at the top cuff.

50% wool / 25% acrylic / 20% nylon / 5% other.
Made in Canada.

Available in two unisex sizes. Refer to the sizing chart for details.

Wash in cold water and hang to dry. To reduce energy and water use, we recommend washing only when necessary. Less washing also gives your garments a longer life.
